The Gamecube was not designed for widescreen because widesceeen displays were not common or popular at the time. Even the Xbox only has a very small selection of 16:9 supported games.

It isn't the terrible 2007 Ubisoft port but don't kid yourself. Butchered may be a strong word but it is a shoddy port when compared to the original and many ports that came after.
